'''''Havoc''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tulimus]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A participant in the siege of [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], it was destroyed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces led by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Pertarn]], when they launched a frontal assault on the ship. With all firepower from the [[Vindicator (light freighter)|''Vindicator'']] aimed at the ship, the ''Havoc'' broke apart.
